$$ \chi_{\mathrm{arc}}(\mathrm{PG}(2,q)) = \begin{cases} q+1 & \text{if } q \text{ is odd} \\ q & \text{if } q \text{ is even} \end{cases} $$
This result is correctly stated in the box: $\boxed{q \text{ if } q \text{ is even, and } q+1 \text{ if } q \text{ is odd}}$.

If $q=2$ (even), the correct answer is $2$. The provided expression yields $2^3 + 2 = 10$.

Since the final numerical answer provided is incorrect, the entire submission is flawed despite the correct derivation preceding it.
